## ⚡ Quick Start
```lua
-- Basic usage example
if (not cipherBot) then return end

-- Create a main window
local window = cipherBot.UI.create("My Window", 400, 300)

-- Add a button
cipherBot.UI.button("Click me", function()
    cipherBot.showAlert({
        title = "Success",
        message = "Button clicked!",
        duration = 2000
    })
end, window.mainPanel)

-- Create a custom widget
cipherBot.Widget.create("myWidget", "Status", "#00FF00")
```

## 🎨 UI Library

### cipherBot.UI.create

Creates a resizable and draggable main window with automatic position management.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| text | string | Yes | "Mrl Scripts" | Window title |
| width | number | Yes | 300 | Width in pixels |
| height | number | Yes | 250 | Height in pixels |
| windowId | string | Yes | text value | Unique window identifier |
| isSimple | boolean | Yes | false | If true, creates SimpleCipherWindow |

#### Return
| Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| table | Created window widget |
| string | Error message in case of failure |

#### Example
```lua
-- Create standard window
local window = cipherBot.UI.create("Settings", 400, 300)

-- Create simple window
local simpleWindow = cipherBot.UI.create("Simple", 200, 150, "myWindow", true)
```

#### Notes
- Window position is automatically centered
- Previous windows with same ID are destroyed
- Supports simple (SimpleCipherWindow) and complete (CipherWindow) themes

### cipherBot.UI.scrollbar

Creates a horizontal scrollbar with value persistence.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| storageName | string | No | — | Storage namespace |
| id | string | No | — | Unique identifier within namespace |
| title | string | No | — | Label displayed above scrollbar |
| min | number | No | — | Minimum value |
| max | number | No | — | Maximum value |
| defaultValue | number | No | — | Initial/default value |
| dest | table | No | — | Parent widget to attach to |
| tooltip | string | Yes | nil | Tooltip text |
| options | table | Yes | {} | Additional options |

#### Options
| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| enableStorage | boolean | true | Enable value persistence |
| onChange | function | nil | Callback when value changes |
| clearOnDestroy | boolean | false | Clear storage when widget is destroyed |
| format | string | "none" | Mode: "none", "percent", "time" |
| timeMode | string | "auto" | Time mode: "s", "m:s", "h:m:s", "d:h:m:s", "auto" |
| timeInMillis | boolean | false | If time is in milliseconds |

#### Return
| Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| table | Scrollbar widget |

#### Example
```lua
-- Simple scrollbar
local scroll = cipherBot.UI.scrollbar("config", "volume", "Volume", 0, 100, 50, parent)

-- Scrollbar with percentage format
local percentScroll = cipherBot.UI.scrollbar("ui", "opacity", "Opacity", 0, 100, 80, parent, nil, {
    format = "percent",
    onChange = function(value)
        print("Opacity changed to: " .. value)
    end
})
```

#### Performance
- Execution time: ~3ms
- Smooth updates with optimized callback

### cipherBot.UI.textedit

Creates a text input field with automatic persistence.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| storageName | string | No | — | Storage namespace |
| id | string | No | — | Unique identifier |
| title | string | No | — | Label above field |
| defaultValue | string | No | — | Initial value |
| dest | table | No | — | Parent widget |
| tooltip | string | Yes | nil | Tooltip text |
| options | table | Yes | {} | Additional options |

#### Options
| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| enableStorage | boolean | true | Persist text |
| onChange | function | nil | Callback when text changes |
| clearOnDestroy | boolean | false | Clear storage when destroyed |

#### Return
| Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| table | Text field widget |

#### Example
```lua
-- Simple text field
local nameField = cipherBot.UI.textedit("player", "name", "Character Name", "", parent)

-- Field with validation
local emailField = cipherBot.UI.textedit("config", "email", "E-mail", "user@example.com", parent, nil, {
    onChange = function(text)
        if not text:match("%S+@%S+%.%S+") then
            cipherBot.showAlert({title = "Error", message = "Invalid email"})
        end
    end
})
```

### cipherBot.UI.switch

Creates a toggle switch with state persistence.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| storageName | string | No | — | Storage namespace |
| id | string | No | — | Unique identifier |
| title | string | No | — | Switch text |
| defaultValue | boolean | No | — | Initial state (on/off) |
| dest | table | No | — | Parent widget |
| tooltip | string | Yes | nil | Tooltip text |
| options | table | Yes | {} | Additional options |

#### Options
| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| enableStorage | boolean | true | Persist state |
| onChange | function | nil | Callback when toggled |
| clearOnDestroy | boolean | false | Clear storage when destroyed |

#### Return
| Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| table | Switch widget |

#### Example
```lua
-- Simple switch
local toggle = cipherBot.UI.switch("config", "autoHeal", "Auto Heal", false, parent)

-- Switch with action
local autoAttack = cipherBot.UI.switch("combat", "autoAttack", "Auto Attack", true, parent, "Enable auto attack", {
    onChange = function(isOn)
        if isOn then
            schedule(100, function() attackNearest() end)
        end
    end
})
```

### cipherBot.UI.checkbox

Creates a checkbox with persistent state.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| storageName | string | No | — | Storage namespace |
| id | string | No | — | Unique identifier |
| title | string | No | — | Text next to checkbox |
| defaultValue | boolean | No | — | Initial state |
| dest | table | No | — | Parent widget |
| tooltip | string | Yes | nil | Tooltip text |
| callback | function | Yes | nil | Legacy callback |
| options | table | Yes | {} | Additional options |

#### Options
| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| enableStorage | boolean | true | Persist state |
| onChange | function | nil | Callback when changed |
| clearOnDestroy | boolean | false | Clear storage when destroyed |

#### Return
| Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| table | Checkbox widget |

#### Example
```lua
-- Basic checkbox
local option = cipherBot.UI.checkbox("config", "showNames", "Show Names", true, parent)

-- Checkbox with multiple actions
local notifications = cipherBot.UI.checkbox("ui", "notifications", "Notifications", true, parent, nil, function(checked)
    if checked then
        enableNotifications()
    else
        disableNotifications()
    end
end, {
    clearOnDestroy = true
})
```

### cipherBot.UI.button

Creates a clickable button.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| text | string | No | — | Button text |
| callback | function | Yes | nil | Function executed on click |
| parent | table | No | — | Parent widget |

#### Return
| Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| table | Button widget |

#### Example
```lua
-- Button with action
cipherBot.UI.button("Save", function(btn)
    saveConfig()
    btn:setText("Saved!")
end, parent)

-- Button without callback (for later use)
local myButton = cipherBot.UI.button("Click me", nil, parent)
myButton.onClick = function()
    print("Button clicked!")
end
```

### cipherBot.UI.combobox

Creates a dropdown combobox with selection persistence.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| storageName | string | No | — | Storage namespace |
| id | string | No | — | Unique identifier |
| text | string | No | — | Label text |
| options | table | No | — | List of options |
| defaultValue | string | No | — | Initial option |
| dest | table | No | — | Parent widget |
| tooltip | string | Yes | nil | Tooltip text |
| callback | function | Yes | nil | Legacy callback |
| extraOptions | table | Yes | {} | Additional options |

#### Options
| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| enableStorage | boolean | true | Persist selection |
| onChange | function | nil | Callback when changed |
| clearOnDestroy | boolean | false | Clear storage when destroyed |

#### Return
| Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| table | Combobox widget |

#### Example
```lua
-- Simple combobox
local classSelector = cipherBot.UI.combobox("player", "class", "Class", 
    {"Warrior", "Mage", "Archer"}, "Warrior", parent)

-- Dynamic combobox
local serverSelector = cipherBot.UI.combobox("config", "server", "Server", 
    getServerList(), "Antica", parent, nil, nil, {
        onChange = function(selected)
            connectToServer(selected)
        end
    })
```

## 🧩 Widget Library

### cipherBot.Widget.create

Creates a draggable custom widget with position and appearance persistence.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| widgetName | string | No | — | Unique widget identifier |
| title | string | No | — | Initial widget title |
| color | string | Yes | — | Initial color (HEX format) |

#### Return
| Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| table | Created widget or nil |

#### Example
```lua
-- Create status widget
local statusWidget = cipherBot.Widget.create("playerStatus", "HP: 100%", "#00FF00")

-- Widget with custom color
local expWidget = cipherBot.Widget.create("expTracker", "EXP: 0%", "#9D4EDD")
```

#### Notes
- Widgets are automatically saved to storage
- Supports dragging with Ctrl key (desktop) or F2 (mobile)
- Position is persisted between sessions

### getCreature

Searches for creatures within a specified area with various filters.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| data | table | No | — | Search parameters |

#### `data` Structure
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| creature | string | "creature" | Type: 'creature', 'player', 'npc', 'monster' |
| area | number | 10 | Search radius |
| multifloor | boolean | false | Include multiple floors |
| byId | boolean | false | Filter by ID |
| id | number | nil | Specific ID |
| byName | boolean | false | Filter by name |
| name | string | nil | Specific name |
| health | number | false | Maximum health percentage |
| attackers | boolean | false | Only attackers |
| byEmblem | boolean | false | Filter by emblem |
| emblem | number/table | nil | Specific emblem(s) |
| byShield | boolean | false | Filter by skull |
| shield | number/table | nil | Specific skull(s) |

#### Return
| Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| number | Total creature count |
| boolean | true if at least one found |
| table | Details of found creatures |

#### Example
```lua
-- Search for attacking players with less than 50% health
local count, found, details = getCreature({
    creature = "player",
    area = 7,
    health = 50,
    attackers = true
})

if found then
    print(count .. " players attacking with low health")
end
```

---

### getTarget

Searches for information about current target with filters.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| data | table | No | — | Search parameters |

#### Return
| Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| number | 1 if target matches filters, 0 otherwise |
| boolean | true if target matches |
| table | Target details |

#### Example
```lua
-- Check if target is monster with less than 30% health
local count, isMonsterLowHP = getTarget({
    creature = "monster",
    health = 30
})

if isMonsterLowHP then
    print("Target is monster with low health")
end
```

### samePos

### extractSpecificTextInString

Extracts specific text between two patterns in a string.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| str | string | No | — | Input string |
| startPattern | string | No | — | Start pattern |
| endPattern | string | No | — | End pattern |
| offsetStart | number | Yes | 1 | Offset for start |
| offsetEnd | number | Yes | -1 | Offset for end |

#### Return
| Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| string | Extracted substring or nil |

#### Example
```lua
local text = "Player [John] says: Hello"
local name = extractSpecificTextInString(text, "%[", "%]")
-- name = "John"
```

### doCast

Casts spell with safety checks against spam.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| spell | string | No | — | Spell name |
| once | boolean | Yes | — | If true, cast only if not stopped |
| callback | function | Yes | nil | Callback to override needStop |

#### Example
```lua
-- Cast spell safely
doCast("exori", true, function(needStop)
    return needStop or mana() < 100
end)

-- Cast every time possible
doCast("utevo lux", false)
```

#### Notes
- Prevents spell spam (200ms cooldown)
- Tracks cast count and time
- Allows callback for custom logic

### cipherBot.createMacroSettings

Creates configuration window for macro with customizable fields.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| macroName | string | No | — | Macro name |
| options | table | Yes | {} | Configuration options |

#### Options
| Field | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| storageAlias | string | Storage alias |
| order | table | Field order |
| hideName | boolean | Hide name field |
| hideKey | boolean | Hide key field |
| hideDelay | boolean | Hide delay field |
| hideTab | boolean | Hide tab field |
| hideIcon | boolean | Hide icon field |
| extraFields | table | Extra fields |

#### Return
| Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| table | Settings window |

#### Example
```lua
local settingsWindow = cipherBot.createMacroSettings("AutoHeal", {
    order = {"name", "delay", "tab"},
    extraFields = {
        {
            type = "scrollbar",
            id = "healPercent",
            storageKey = "healPercent",
            label = "Healing Percentage",
            min = 10,
            max = 100,
            default = 70
        }
    }
})
```

### cipherBot.macro

## 🎯 Icon Library

### cipherBot.Icon.create

Creates interactive icon on game screen.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| id | string | No | — | Unique icon ID |
| options | table | No | — | Icon options |
| callback | function | No | — | Callback function |

#### Options
| Field | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| item | table/number | Item to display |
| image | string | Local image |
| imageUrl | string | Image URL |
| outfit | table | Creature outfit |
| creatureId | number | Creature ID |
| text | string | Icon text |
| x | number | X position (0.0-1.0) |
| y | number | Y position (0.0-1.0) |
| hotkey | string | Shortcut key |
| switchable | boolean | true | If can toggle |
| movable | boolean | true | If can move |
| phantom | boolean | false | If phantom |

#### Return
| Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| table | Icon widget |

#### Example
```lua
-- Item icon
cipherBot.Icon.create("healPotion", {
    item = {id = 7618, count = 10},
    text = "Heal",
    x = 0.1,
    y = 0.5,
    hotkey = "F1"
}, function(widget, isOn)
    if isOn then
        useItem(7618)
    end
end)

-- Outfit icon
cipherBot.Icon.create("playerTracker", {
    outfit = {type = 128, head = 94, body = 113, legs = 115, feet = 115},
    text = "Track"
}, trackPlayer)
```

## 🔔 Alert Library

### cipherBot.showAlert

Displays temporary notification on screen.

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Optional | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| params | table | No | — | Alert parameters |

#### `params` Structure
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| title | string | "Alert" | Alert title |
| message | string | "" | Alert message |
| duration | number | 2000 | Duration in milliseconds |
| outDuration | number | 500 | Exit animation duration |
| colorBorder | string | "#9D4EDD" | Border color |
| colorTitle | string | "#9D4EDD" | Title color |
| colorText | string | "#E0E0E0" | Text color |

#### Example
```lua
-- Simple alert
cipherBot.showAlert({
    title = "Warning",
    message = "Low mana!",
    duration = 1500
})

-- Custom alert
cipherBot.showAlert({
    title = "Danger",
    message = "Critical health! Using potion...",
    duration = 3000,
    colorBorder = "#FF0000",
    colorTitle = "#FF5555",
    colorText = "#FFFFFF"
})
```

#### Notes
- Automatic size based on text length
- Progress bar shows remaining time
- Fade in/out animations supported
- Multiple alerts are queued

## 🎯 Advanced Examples

### Complete Auto Heal System
```lua
if (not cipherBot) then return end

-- Set default tab
cipherBot.setDefaultTab("Healing")

-- Create settings window
local window = cipherBot.UI.create("Auto Heal", 350, 400)

-- Basic settings section
local basicSection = cipherBot.UI.section("Basic Settings", window.mainPanel)

cipherBot.UI.switch("autoHeal", "enabled", "Enable Auto Heal", false, basicSection)
cipherBot.UI.scrollbar("autoHeal", "healthPercent", "Heal below %", 10, 100, 50, basicSection, nil, {
    format = "percent"
})

-- Healing items section
local itemsSection = cipherBot.UI.section("Healing Items", window.mainPanel)

cipherBot.UI.item("autoHeal", "healthPotion", "Health Potion", 7618, itemsSection)
cipherBot.UI.scrollbar("autoHeal", "potionHealth", "Health for potion %", 10, 100, 30, itemsSection, nil, {
    format = "percent"
})

-- Spells section
local spellsSection = cipherBot.UI.section("Spells", window.mainPanel)

cipherBot.UI.switch("autoHeal", "useExura", "Use Exura", true, spellsSection)
cipherBot.UI.scrollbar("autoHeal", "exuraHealth", "Health for Exura %", 10, 100, 70, spellsSection, nil, {
    format = "percent"
})

-- Execution macro
cipherBot.macro(100, "AutoHeal", "Ctrl+H", function()
    if not cipherBot.storage.autoHeal.enabled then return end
    
    local hpPercent = healthpercent()
    local player = g_game.getLocalPlayer()
    
    -- Use health potion
    if hpPercent <= cipherBot.storage.autoHeal.potionHealth then
        local potionId = cipherBot.storage.autoHeal.healthPotion
        if itemAmount(potionId) > 0 then
            useItem(potionId)
            return
        end
    end
    
    -- Use spell
    if cipherBot.storage.autoHeal.useExura and hpPercent <= cipherBot.storage.autoHeal.exuraHealth then
        if mana() >= 20 then
            doCast("exura", true)
        end
    end
end)
```

### PZ Alert System
```lua
if (not cipherBot) then return end

-- PZ status widget
local pzWidget = cipherBot.Widget.create("pzStatus", "Out of PZ", "#00FF00")

-- Macro to monitor PZ
cipherBot.macro(500, "PZMonitor", "", function()
    local player = g_game.getLocalPlayer()
    if not player then return end
    
    if player:isInPz() then
        cipherBot.Widget.changeText("pzStatus", "IN PZ!", "#FF0000")
        cipherBot.Widget.changeColor("pzStatus", "#FF0000")
        
        -- Visual/audio alert
        cipherBot.showAlert({
            title = "PZ ALERT",
            message = "You are in Protected Zone!",
            duration = 3000,
            colorBorder = "#FF0000",
            colorTitle = "#FF5555"
        })
    else
        cipherBot.Widget.changeText("pzStatus", "Out of PZ", "#00FF00")
        cipherBot.Widget.changeColor("pzStatus", "#00FF00")
    end
end)
```

### Spell Rotation System
```lua
if (not cipherBot) then return end

-- Set up tab
cipherBot.setDefaultTab("Rotation")

-- Create spell list
cipherBot.storage.spellRotation = cipherBot.storage.spellRotation or {
    spells = {
        {name = "exori", enabled = true, mana = 20},
        {name = "exori gran", enabled = true, mana = 110},
        {name = "exori mort", enabled = false, mana = 20}
    }
}

-- Configuration window
local window = cipherBot.UI.create("Spell Rotation", 300, 350)
local spellList = cipherBot.UI.scrollablePanel("Spells", window.mainPanel)

-- Function to insert list
local function refreshSpellList()
    insertSpellList(spellList.list, cipherBot.storage.spellRotation, {
        show = {"enabled", "remove"}
    }, function(entry)
        return entry.name .. " (" .. entry.mana .. " mana)"
    end)
end

-- Button to add spell
cipherBot.UI.button("Add Spell", function()
    local spellName = "exori"
    table.insert(cipherBot.storage.spellRotation.spells, {
        name = spellName,
        enabled = true,
        mana = 20
    })
    cipherBot.doSaveFile()
    refreshSpellList()
end, window.mainPanel)

-- Rotation macro
cipherBot.macro(1000, "SpellRotation", "", function()
    if not target() then return end
    
    for _, spell in ipairs(cipherBot.storage.spellRotation.spells) do
        if spell.enabled and mana() >= spell.mana then
            doCast(spell.name, true)
            break
        end
    end
end)

-- Initialize list
refreshSpellList()
```
